scope: Strict brush numbers and flags, degenerate-side safety, finite derived UVs and safe plane hashing
limits: Generated fixtures; not all authored MAP files or script consumers are covered.
Large-distance hash controls use onlyents and do not qualify giant-world BSP compilation.
Winding UV preflight only runs where source geometry is constructed; final emission errors can occur later.
No new performance, renderer equivalence, general MAP sandbox or portable package claim.
Linux area_factors is skipped when no GPU backend is available.
ASan leak detection retains the established process-lifetime exclusions.
Known include-lookahead, quoted-line-accounting, CLI-sign, raw-sidecar, VIS and Windows delay issues remain open.
